correctness.rationale: The lower bound is proved for every admissible subdivision by converting each outer-circle trace of diameter at most \(2\sin(\pi/7)\) into an arc of angular length at most \(2\pi/7\); seven shorter arcs cannot cover the circle. The explicit centered-core construction is verified by exact maximization of the squared distance over a sector, and the mixed radial corner is strictly subextremal because \(\sin(\pi/7)>2/5\). Equality on the boundary follows from equality in the seven-arc cover. No finite experiment is used as proof.
